snippet.title: Super Fun: Football | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play arcade football online or locally with friends, on the same team or against each other. Score bicycle kicks, celebrate together, and try not to take out your own teammates.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5324740/Super_Fun_Football/

Follow Super Fun for gameplay and updates.
